## Description

R25: The existing leaf-view overlay tests pass unchanged.
R30: The Playwright test opens a phase page through the real server.

## Approach

- Run the Playwright suite through the real server: `cd dashboard/frontend && npm run e2e`.
- Run the leaf-view tests and check that none of those files changed against `da02eb681`.
- Run `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` in `dashboard/frontend`.
- Run `uvx ruff@0.13.1 check .`, `uv run basedpyright` and the dashboard structure tests from the repo root.
- Record a check-run for each acceptance. Run `canon validate`.
